     5→import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
     6→import androidx.navigation3.runtime.NavKey
     7→import androidx.navigation3.runtime.entryProvider
     8→import androidx.navigation3.ui.NavDisplay

    10→import org.koin.compose.getKoin

    12→import template.ui.common.theme.AppTheme
    13→import template.ui.main.MainScreen
    14→import template.ui.splash.SplashScreen
    15→
    16→@Preview
    17→@Composable
    18→fun NavApp() =
    19→    AppTheme {
    20→        val koin = getKoin()
    21→        val backStack = mutableStateListOf<NavKey>(AppRoutes.Splash)
    22→        val appNavigation = AppNavigation(backStack = backStack)
    23→        NavDisplay(
    24→            backStack = backStack,
    25→            onBack = { backStack.removeLastOrNull() },
    26→            entryProvider =
    27→                entryProvider {
    28→                    entry<AppRoutes.Splash> {
    29→                        SplashScreen {
    30→                            koin.get { parametersOf(appNavigation) }
    31→                        }
    32→                    }
    33→                    entry<AppRoutes.Main> {
    34→                        MainScreen {
    35→                            koin.get { parametersOf(it.initArg, appNavigation) }
    36→                        }
    37→                    }
    38→                },
    39→        )
    40→    }
    41→
    42→internal sealed interface AppRoutes : NavKey {
    43→    @Serializable
    44→    data object Splash : AppRoutes
    45→
    46→    @Serializable
    47→    data class Main(
    48→        val initArg: String,
    49→    ) : AppRoutes
    50→}
